chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Muskan, from Abdillah ibn Sulayman, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) would not turn away any beggar when it was the Day of Arafah.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far (a title for Imam Muhammad al-Baqir)

ai.seo_question: What was the charitable practice of Imam al-Baqir on the Day of Arafah?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal* highlights the specific generosity of Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) on the Day of Arafah, a date of profound spiritual significance in both Sunni and Shia traditions. By ensuring no supplicant was sent away empty-handed, the Imam exemplified the virtue of *sadaqah* as a means of drawing closer to God during this auspicious time, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on imitating the Imams' moral conduct in daily worship.
